Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_14331",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"process_head_file_extra",
    "line":1422,"var":"extra_field_id","code":"read_var_sized(a, &extra_field_id, &var_size)",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input-controlled extra_field_id value 0x06 (EX_UOWNER) is read from the archive, routing execution to parse_file_extra_owner"},
   {"step":2,"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner",
    "line":1350,"var":"value_len","code":"read_var_sized(a, &value_len, NULL)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Input-controlled owner name length (value_len=256) is read from the archive stream"},
   {"step":3,"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner",
    "line":1355,"var":"value_len","code":"if (value_len > OWNER_MAXNAMELEN) name_len = OWNER_MAXNAMELEN; else name_len = value_len;",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Off-by-one: condition uses > instead of >=, so when value_len==256==OWNER_MAXNAMELEN the else branch sets name_len=256, which will overflow the 256-byte buffer on the null terminator write"},
   {"step":4,"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner",
    "line":1360,"var":"namebuf[name_len]","code":"namebuf[name_len] = 0;",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Writes null byte at namebuf[256], one byte past the end of the 256-byte stack buffer (stack-buffer-overflow WRITE 1)"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"process_head_file_extra",
     "line":1422,"operands":["extra_field_id"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner",
     "line":1355,"operands":["value_len","OWNER_MAXNAMELEN"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"value_len","right":"OWNER_MAXNAMELEN"}},
   "sink":{"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner",
     "line":1360,"operands":["name_len","OWNER_MAXNAMELEN"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"name_len","right":"OWNER_MAXNAMELEN"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"process_head_file_extra",
       "line":1422,"operands":["extra_field_id"]},
      "to":{"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner",
       "line":1350,"operands":["value_len"]},
      "type":"control","via":["extra_field_id == EX_UOWNER"]},
     {"from":{"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner",
       "line":1350,"operands":["value_len"]},
      "to":{"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner",
       "line":1355,"operands":["value_len"]},
      "type":"data","via":["value_len"]},
     {"from":{"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner",
       "line":1355,"operands":["name_len"]},
      "to":{"file":"libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner",
       "line":1360,"operands":["namebuf[name_len]"]},
      "type":"data","via":["name_len"]}
   ]
 }}
